description: This Java class 'MD5Checksum' provides utility methods for generating MD5 checksums of files. It includes methods to create a checksum byte array and to get the checksum as a hexadecimal string, based on the contents of a specified file.

classes.name: MD5Checksum
classes.description: Utility class for computing MD5 checksums of files.

methods.name: createChecksum
methods.description: Reads the file specified by filename and computes its MD5 checksum, returning it as a byte array.

methods.name: getMD5Checksum
methods.description: Returns the MD5 checksum of the specified file as a hexadecimal string.
